contacts.list.description: Candidate documented Microsoft Graph GET /v1.0/me identity and GET /v1.0/me/contacts with fixed selected fields; requires authorized account, ID, nullable-field, and continuation verification before execution

limit.description: Page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 100

cursor.description: Continuation returned for this exact account and request

calendar.attendees.list.description: Candidate documented Microsoft Graph GET /v1.0/me identity and GET /v1.0/me/calendar/calendarView; fixed minimal fields exclude subject, body, location, and attachments; requires authorized recurrence, UTC, visibility, and continuation verification before execution

limit.description: Page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 100

cursor.description: Continuation returned for this exact account and request

start.description: Inclusive window start in whole-second UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.000Z

end.description: Exclusive window end in whole-second UTC, at most 90 days after start
